dependency_nodes.statement: Marked shadow q_(k+1)<=q_k when |V(G)|<=2k by deletion-extension incidence counting.
For |V(G)|<=2k+1, k>=2, and at least two edges, arbitrary marked family has q_(k+1)<=q_k; uses A, ordinary shadow, and first-wide classification.
For |V(G)|=2k+2, tau(G)>=3, and W with a non-isolated mark, q_(k+1)<=q_k; uses the two-part split and B.
On |V(T)|=2p+2, x(T)+2<=p forces tau(T)>=4; uses the registered Catalan floor and explicit all-ranks positivity.
For H=T-{v,s_v}, W=N(s_v)-{v}, tau(H)=tau(T)-1 and q_p-q_(p-1) equals the original tagged leaf summand.
All original leaf summands are nonpositive at this shell, hence the fixed favorable subset sum is nonpositive.
